description: Gate and verify autonomous AI agent action decisions (e.g. trades, emails, claims, API calls, wallet transfers) via EthersFlow Multi-Model Federated Adversarial Consensus before execution.

agent_action.description: The proposed action or decision the autonomous agent intends to take.

agent_count.description: Number of adversarial audit nodes (1 to 5, default 3).

context.description: Optional structured context or evidence payload.

custom_personas.description: Optional inline array of custom analyst roles or persona objects ({ role, instructions }) for flexible domain reviews.

persona_instructions.description: Optional inline custom instructions appended to all council auditor system prompts.

persona_preset.description: Built-in audit preset (clinical_safety, financial_compliance, legal_citation, cybersecurity_auditor, general_adversarial) or a registered custom persona ID/slug.

policy.description: Optional inline custom policy rules object (max_amount_usd, blocked_verbs, blocked_keywords, allowed_domains, blocked_domains, require_ticket_anchor, custom_instructions).

policy_id.description: Optional system or custom policy ID to evaluate against.

reasoning_chain.description: Optional internal reasoning chain or context supporting the decision.

scope_grant.description: Platform-registered cryptographic scope grant ({ grant_id, grant_signature }) provisioned via POST /api/v1/scope-grants. Self-attested or unregistered grants fail closed (FORGED_OR_UNREGISTERED_SCOPE_GRANT).

scope_hint.description: Optional domain or task scope hint (e.g. 'clinical_safety', 'financial_compliance', 'legal_citation', 'cybersecurity_auditor').

name: verify_agent_action
